title: This grey sky was a science lesson

segments.text: This grey sky? It was a science lesson.
Smoke that travelled hundreds of kilometres. Mosquitoes that fight dengue. And a country with no oil or gas of its own.
Here's one. The tiniest haze particles are thirty times thinner than your hair.
So small, they slip past your nose, straight into your lungs.
Every Thursday on TheOneApp, Explored, we take one real news story and show you the science from your textbook. Primary Three to Primary Six.
Subscribe, so next week you'll find out how Singapore keeps the lights on.
